notes.title: Disastr_Blastr Game Release Imminent!
notes.notes:
Hey friends! Just 2 more days until the release of Disastr_Blastr, I hope all of you are ready to smash some blocks! Feel free to post your thoughts and questions here in the Community threads, on the official FB page, or Tweet with #destroyallcubes! 

Quick update on the official game soundtrack—I have received all the final tracks from Joey, and will be publishing them as DLC shortly following the release of the game on Monday. The music is one of the absolute best parts of this game, I know you guys are going to dig it. :) 

Looking forward to all of your feedback on the game! Have a great weekend everyone, see you on Monday for the big release!!!!


~Joel
